verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a public REST API, Microsoft Graph, with a single endpoint (https://graph.microsoft.com) and per-operation reference pages, such as listing Entra user objects. That lets an AI-native user drive core directory operations programmatically. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at the learn.microsoft.com paths it tried; this does not contradict the documented REST API, but it limits machine-readable discovery. Missing for 10: evidence that API coverage extends beyond user listing to Entra management areas (Conditional Access, lifecycle workflows, entitlement management), a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
